mechanism: Bumetanide-induced electrolyte depletion (hypokalemia, hyponatremia) and dehydration can potentiate opioid effects and increase CNS depression risk, while loop diuretics may increase buprenorphine levels through volume depletion-related altered pharmacokinetics.
action: Monitor electrolytes, blood pressure, and respiratory status closely; ensure adequate hydration; consider alternative diuretics if possible; adjust buprenorphine dosing if clinically indicated based on patient response.
